verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Fastmail blocking remote images or tracking pixels, by default or otherwise. The only related material is one community remark that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled', which is not first-party documentation of a privacy or tracking-protection capability. Masked Email is an adjacent anti-tracking feature (aliases for sign-ups), not read-pixel blocking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
